blocks.text: Fire Safety Solutions

In a fast paced world, there should always be arrangements done for fire and safety solutions. People may not be able to concentrate on their work and feel comfortable in such vulnerable environments. So it is important to follow the fire and safety solutions in every work environment.

There are diverse ways and many fire and safety equipment to stop a fire in its tracks. An active state of mind and presence can always help to tackle serious conditions like this that could arise anytime, anywhere. An effective workplace should follow some preventative measures. Here are some of the fire safety checklist of preventative measures that can and should be implemented throughout every workplaces.
Fire Alarm System

Fire alarm system is one among the many components that assure safety. A well-designed, installed and maintained fire alarm system can provide a better coverage of safety in workplaces. It is rather mandatory to install fire alarm systems in almost all the institutions including small offices, 500 bedroom hotels or large industrial sites.

Sprinkler System

A fire sprinkler system is an active fire protection measure, which consists of a water supply system which provides an adequate pressure and flow rate to a water distribution piping system, onto which fire sprinklers are connected. The heat from a fire activates the sprinkler system to perform its action. If a sprinkler is present, a glass bulb or solder link gets hot and at a specific temperature breaks, releasing a cap and allowing water to flow onto a diffuser.

Our fire safety company in Dubai offers installation and maintenance of sprinkler systems to various small and large-scale institutions throughout the UAE. Fire sprinkler systems are a must in every institution as they help to prevent the spread of a fire by extinguishing them as soon as they have been detected. There are various types of fire sprinklers and with our service we can help you to make the right choice.
Fire Extinguisher

A fire extinguisher is the best choice at the time of small fires. A fire extinguisher consists of a hand-held cylindrical pressure vessel containing an agent that can be discharged to extinguish a fire. You can get fire extinguishers in Dubai with us, for we provide all the services relating to fire and safety solutions.

There are various types of fire extinguishers including dry chemicals, carbon dioxide, water and foam, wet chemicals, clean agent, and dry powder. We also provide fire extinguisher services in Dubai which includes inspection, testing, and portable fire extinguisher services. Depending upon the type of fire extinguisher installed, it is important and also a legal requirement to replace them every 5 to 10 years.
Fire Fighting System

Firefighting is the act of attempting to prevent the spread of and extinguish significant unwanted fires in buildings, vehicles, woodlands, etc. You can get your fire fighting system installed in your work premises or industrial premises with our help. Our team will help you from design to success completion of fire fighting installation in your building as per NFPA standards and building codes.

Emergency Lighting

Emergency lighting system ensures safe movement, evacuation and life safety. Emergency situations can occur anytime. And it's human nature to panic when faced with such a situation especially if it's fire. To reduce and eliminate the emergencies that might be caused due to the crisis it is rather important to evacuate people quickly and get them to safety.
